name: amalgix
description: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) document intelligence with x402 micropayments. Multiple AI models cross-verify each other — hallucinations caught before they reach you. 3-tier smart routing, 100% accuracy across 10 languages.

tools.name: analyze_document
tools.description: Deep document analysis with MoA cross-provider verification. Multiple AI models extract findings independently, then a Critic validates every claim against the source text. Automatically routes to fastest/cheapest pipeline: single-pass (<128KB), large-context (128KB–3.2MB), or chunked MoA (>3.2MB). Returns structured JSON with findings, evidence, and confidence scores.
tools.pricing: dynamic — from $0.08 (small doc) to $15.00 (20MB cap). Call estimate_cost first.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: FREE: Get a precise price quote before paying. Pass your content to see exact USDC cost, routing tier, and estimated latency.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: FREE: Check service availability, engine status, and uptime before dispatching paid calls.

tools.name: extract_web
tools.description: Extract and analyze content from any URL. Supports JavaScript-rendered pages.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Fast, cheap summary with key points. Best for short documents. Cheaper than analyze_document.

tools.name: delegate_coding
tools.description: Generate, review, or extract code. Modes: generate, review, extract. Returns structured code blocks.

tools.name: delegate_bulk_translate
tools.description: Translate all string values in a JSON object to any target language. Preserves structure and non-string values. Auto-chunks large payloads.

routing.tier3: > 3.2MB — Chunked MoA: 2× Flash workers + Haiku critic per chunk, Sonnet manager synthesis, ~30s–2min

privacy: Document content is transmitted to third-party LLM providers (Google, Anthropic) for processing. Do not submit documents containing passwords, private keys, SSNs, or other regulated PII.
